newsitem.title: USA: Kodak extends contract of CFO, adds stock options.
newsitem.headline: Kodak extends contract of CFO, adds stock options.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Friday it has signed a two-year contract extension with its chief financial officer, Harry Kavetas.
The company said that key provisions in the contract extension will be included in the company's 10K report, to be filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Kavetas will receive a stock option grant of 200,000 shares at $88.50 per share, vesting over four years and exercisable over 10 years. He will receive a grant of 10,000 shares of restricted stock, with restrictions lapsing at the end of his contract.
The extension did not include an increase in his base pay or any cash bonus.
The terms of this extension, which expires Feb 10, 2001, are amendments to Kavetas' current contract, which expires Feb 10, 1999.
Kavetas joined Kodak in Feb, 1994 as senior vice president and chief financial officer; he was elected an executive vice president on September 19, 1994.
